def transform(grid):
    div = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if 5 in row)
    top, bottom = grid[:div], grid[div+1:]
    counts = {}
    for color in (2, 4):
        a = sum(v == color for row in top for v in row)
        b = sum(v == color for row in bottom for v in row)
        counts[color] = abs(a-b)
    winner = max((2, 4), key=lambda c: counts[c])
    return [[winner, winner], [winner, winner]]
All demonstrations validated.
